secrets.name: LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for the AI Recovery Assistant (https://console.groq.com/keys). Without it the assistant returns 503 — the rest of the app works fine.

secrets.name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
secrets.description: Twilio Account SID for real SMS OTP (https://console.twilio.com). Optional — demo OTP mode is enabled by default.

secrets.name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Twilio Auth Token for SMS OTP. Optional — demo mode shows codes on screen.

secrets.name: TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE_SID
secrets.description: Twilio Verify Service SID for SMS OTP. Optional in demo mode.

secrets.name: LENDSURE_SMTP_USER
secrets.description: Gmail address for email OTP delivery (use an App Password). Optional — demo mode shows codes on screen.

secrets.name: LENDSURE_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Gmail App Password for SMTP email OTP. Optional in demo mode.

secrets.name: SENDGRID_API_KEY
secrets.description: SendGrid API key for HTTPS email delivery (fallback when SMTP ports are blocked). Optional.

secrets.name: NEWS_API_KEY
secrets.description: NewsAPI.org key for live market headlines (https://newsapi.org/register). Without it, seeded data is used.
